```406:425:/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPad/Devices Views/iPad_DeviceMapView.swift
@ViewBuilder
private func scaleBarView() -> some View {
    Group {
        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {
            if let region = currentRegion ?? cameraPosition.region {
                Button(action: { resetZoomToSettings() }) {
                    MapScaleBar(region: region, width: 50, scale: 2)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .padding([.bottom, .trailing], 5)
                .zIndex(2)
            }
        } else {
            Button(action: { resetZoomToSettings() }) {
                MapScaleBar(region: region, width: 50, scale: 2)
                    .id("scalebar")
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .padding([.bottom, .trailing], 5)
            .zIndex(2)
        }
    }
}
```


- `MapScaleBar` now supports scaling:
```13:36:/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/Common/MapScaleBar.swift
struct MapScaleBar: View {
    let region: MKCoordinateRegion
    let width: CGFloat
    let scale: CGFloat

    init(region: MKCoordinateRegion, width: CGFloat, scale: CGFloat = 1.0) {
        self.region = region
        self.width = width
        self.scale = scale
    }

    var body: some View {
        let effectiveWidth = width * scale
        let distance = distanceForWidth(region: region, width: effectiveWidth)
        let label = distanceLabel(for: distance)
        VStack(spacing: 2) {
            Text(label)
                .font(.caption2)
                .foregroundColor(.primary)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.5)
            Rectangle()
                .frame(width: width, height: 2)
                .foregroundColor(.primary)
                .cornerRadius(4)
        }
        .frame(width: width)
        .padding(4)
        .background(.ultraThinMaterial)
        .cornerRadius(8)
        .scaleEffect(scale)
    }
}
```
